findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of key material is disabled by default, increasing exposure in the event of long-term key compromise for a key protecting audit trail data.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key_policy or policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM. This means any IAM principal with sufficiently broad IAM permissions can manage or use the key, weakening least-privilege control over encryption of the audit trail bucket.
